trapNote: A classic test: in cursive, 'шинши' becomes a single wave of 11 identical vertical strokes.
'л' and 'и' blend into consecutive bottom-hook arches.
'м', 'и', and 'л' run together in identical rhythmic peaks.
The ascenders and loops of 'д' and 'ш' can confuse eye tracking.
Lowercase cursive 'т' looks like Latin 'm', right next to 'п' and 'и'.
